parameters.query:
SELECT $1::text AS search_term,
       m.category,
       m.category_title,
       m.matching_codes
FROM (
  SELECT left(c.code, 3) AS category,
         COALESCE(t.long_desc, '') AS category_title,
         count(*) AS matching_codes
  FROM icd10cm c
  LEFT JOIN icd10cm t ON t.code = left(c.code, 3)
  WHERE c.is_billable
    AND to_tsvector('english', c.search_text) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1::text)
  GROUP BY left(c.code, 3), COALESCE(t.long_desc, '')
) m
ORDER BY m.matching_codes DESC, m.category;

SELECT $1::text AS category,
       code,
       long_desc,
       count(*) OVER () AS total_in_category
FROM icd10cm
WHERE is_billable
  AND left(code, 3) = $1::text
ORDER BY code
LIMIT 200;

parameters.text:
=
Extract the diagnoses that the provider documented as present or assessed in the clinical note below.
Rules:
- Exclude anything ruled out, negated, or only mentioned as absent.
- search_term: the diagnosis in plain medical words, including any specificity the note states (type, acuity, cause, severity, body site, laterality, and phrases such as "without complications"). Expand abbreviations. Do not add details the note does not state.
- evidence must be an exact quote copied from the note, character for character, with no added or removed punctuation.
- Return ONLY valid JSON, no other text, in this shape:
{"diagnoses":[{"search_term":"...","evidence":"..."}]}

Note:
{{ $json.note }}
